name: Strelitzia
source: Strelitzia is a Keyblade wielder who lives in Daybreak Town. Despite being very shy and timid, she quickly takes a liking to Player upon seeing them go on adventures on the worlds she's visiting. Her greatest wish is to one day, find the courage to befriend them. She has an older brother named Lauriam. He thinks Strelitzia has a knack for using magic. She seems to love gardening, evident by the abundance of plants in her room.
